execution: Root only; verified isolated display and P1 keyboard path; never the physical user game

Install mcm-browse-observer.lua as isolated validation main.lua and copy ce_compat_probe.lua beside it
Use a clean safe Isaac starting room, one player, controls enabled, menu initially closed
Wait for HFMCM_READY with default_L=true; if false, use the logged existing keyboard binding, do not rebind
Begin synchronized capture and record actual key-down/up timestamps

sequence.verify: Compare category repeat sequence/cadence to native60
HFMCM closed then HFMCM_FINAL settings_unchanged=true, ControlsEnabled restored

coverage: Open, category browsing, held-key repeat, close, visible text/sprites and unchanged registered setting values. No entering/changing options or preview buttons; popup and option editing remain untested.
